targets.expr: ((sum by(immich_host) (immich_inventory_assets{immich_host=~"$host",state="active"})) and on(immich_host) (immich_collector_success{immich_host=~"$host",component="inventory"} == 1) and on(immich_host) (time()-immich_collector_timestamp_seconds{immich_host=~"$host",component="inventory"}<180)) - on(immich_host) ((immich_inventory_unique_originals{immich_host=~"$host"}) and on(immich_host) (immich_collector_success{immich_host=~"$host",component="inventory"} == 1) and on(immich_host) (time()-immich_collector_timestamp_seconds{immich_host=~"$host",component="inventory"}<180))

Workflow state
panels.description: Deferred means waiting for a prerequisite or coordination lock. It is not a completed capture or failure. Last success remains independent.

panels.title: Container restart count
panels.description: Docker restart counter for this container, not lifetime service failures; recreating a container resets the count.

panels.title: Process CPU · sum of user and system
panels.description: CPU seconds per second; 100% equals one fully used core.

panels.title: Repository operations / second
panels.description: Instrumented repository calls, not HTTP requests.

panels.title: Mean repository operation latency
panels.description: Native durations are milliseconds. No observations means no latency sample; no artificial zero is inserted.

panels.title: Failed jobs · rolling hour
panels.description: Native failure counters, independently of the retained failed queue records. A counter must have observations to show a value.

panels.title: Filesystem free space
panels.description: NAS mounts may share the same underlying pool; do not sum their capacity.

options.content: Inventory and queue reads run every minute. Inventory, jobs and backup panels hide values after a component failure or 3 minutes without a successful read. Collection health stays visible. Native HTTP request metrics are not emitted by the tested Immich version, so repository operations are labelled separately. Counts include active originals; trash is separate. Logical content size is not NAS disk usage. Account labels are private and opt-in. Backup history and verification timestamps are reported as recorded; this dashboard does not run backups or mutate media.
